notes: Prices per 1M tokens (tokens) or per hour of audio (audio), on-demand/standard tier.
Thinking tokens are billed as output. cachedInput applies to implicit or explicit cache hits; cacheWrite to Claude cache writes.
Each model lists dated periods: a call is priced by the period it falls in (from inclusive, until exclusive, UTC dates).
Check these against the SKU prices in Cloud Billing (Billing > Pricing) and Groq's pricing page when a model or a promotion changes, then bump version.
A model missing here is recorded with cost_usd null, and `npm run ai:costs` reports it as unpriced.
